# Execution review | 11 November 2026 | Full coverage
Fixed UTC session, 00:00-24:00. Reviewed all **36 database objects**: 12 tables, 17 regular views, 5 materialized views and 2 live views. Full coverage list is at the end, with executable evidence panels above it. Historical performance and audit cutoffs are pinned. Automatic refresh is off.

**Revised conclusion:** the gasoil adverse-selection signal and small-sample counterparty watchlist remain. The expanded review also finds a material Brent position-limit issue, an EEX recorded quote gap, and four corrected volatility marks. These need separate owners and explanations.
cells.name: Scope and revised conclusion

cells.value:
## Execution findings
- **Gasoil, ICE, March-October delivery starts:** 43 aggressive fills, -8.32 bps at 5m and -$28,125. Initial cost is -2.92 bps against a 2.69 bps half-spread. Incremental move is -5.41 bps, paired t=-3.79, with both buys and sells losing. Tuesday's comparable 35 fills move only -0.18 bps after execution. Consistent with adverse selection or signal timing; no identifiable economic opponent behind exchange clearing.
- **Counterparty watchlist:** UTILITY_02: 6 Wednesday trades, -13.60 bps / -$134,140 at 5m. UTILITY_10: 6 active trades, -13.34 bps / -$15,093 at 5m, -$34,163 at 30m. Its two-day result is 16 trades, -8.37 bps / -$67,204 at 5m. UTILITY_02's peer-residual t is only -1.31; UTILITY_10 has only 4 matched observations. UTILITY_05 and TRADER_04 remain poor against coarse peers but have only 3 and 5 Wednesday trades. Forty counterparties were screened. No accusation of informed conduct is established.
- **Common market shock:** 09:20-10:00 UTC NBP sells (n=16) start at -0.16 bps then reach -63.15 bps / -$95,216 at 5m, and -$467,009 at 30m. Six NBP buys gain 70.67 bps at 5m. This is shared upward market exposure or timing, not by itself evidence of bad fills.
- **Aggregate:** original exchange fills +$240,324 at 5m; corrected broker +$162,470 and OTC +$79,797. Total about +$482,590 gross mark-to-mid. These are not realised profit or a causal estimate of execution skill.
cells.name: Execution findings

cells.value:
## Additional findings from the coverage review
- **Risk control:** CRUDE Brent reaches **2.94m barrels at 07:29:26 UTC using information booked at the time**, against the supplied configured **2m-barrel limit**. Fully restating prior-day late trades gives a **3.05m-barrel economic peak (152.5%)**, above the supplied limit for **74.21 minutes, 07:20:39-08:34:52 UTC**. The 119,000-barrel difference in prior-day opening exposure explains why the initial reconstruction gave 2.931m. This is position/limit control, not proof of picking off. The supplied limit/master records are 12 Nov snapshots, so historical limit applicability cannot be certified from this dataset.
- **Reconciliation, not missing trades:** 32 Tuesday trades first booked Wednesday explain the apparent mismatch between Wednesday's opening snapshot plus Wednesday trades and Thursday's opening snapshot. Adding them yields **zero discrepancy across 107 book/symbol keys**. Separately, 8 Wednesday broker and 26 Wednesday OTC trades first arrive Thursday. Daily live position views contain only cumulative exchange fills; the ledger adds opening snapshots but still omits broker/OTC. Neither is complete desk inventory.
- **Recorded EEX gap:** no EEX quotes anywhere in the database from 08:45 to 08:48 UTC; other sources continue. There are **zero EEX fills** in that interval. Sparse historical quotes should not be treated as fresh benchmarks. The primary-source materialized bars intentionally exclude EEX, so they cannot monitor that feed.
- **Volatility marks:** four TTF_Mar-27 ATM observations at 10:30, 10:35, 10:40 and 10:45 UTC are revised upward by **0.08 IV, or 8 volatility points**. Four original total-variance term-shape inversions disappear using highest versions. Different energy delivery contracts are different underlyings; this is a shape/revision diagnostic, not a model-free arbitrage result. No option executions or vega exposures establish a trading loss.
- **Model and curve marking:** champion winter monthly bias is about -285 bps TTF, -286 NBP and -238 UKPWR versus roughly -7/-7/-6 bps for the challenger. Independent raw-quote noon checks confirm the Wednesday anomaly and show Tuesday controls near zero. Input timestamps are recent, which alone does not prove inputs are economically current. Thirty manual TTF_Q1-27 marks at 08:00-08:29 are EUR 2.50/MWh above corrected market marks; weighted constituent months corroborate this. This is model/valuation control, with no model/order linkage proving fill causality.
cells.name: Risk, data and valuation findings

cells.value: DECLARE @asof:='2026-11-11T23:59:59.999999'::timestamp WITH obs AS (SELECT t.trade_id,t.ts,t.book,t.trader,t.symbol,t.curve,t.venue,t.passive,t.qty,t.px,h.offset/1000000000.0 horizon_s,q.ts quote_ts,sign(t.qty)*((q.bid+q.ask)/2-t.px)/t.px*10000 bps,(q.ask-q.bid)/t.px*5000 halfspread,(t.ts+h.offset-q.ts)/1000000000.0 age_s FROM energy_fills t HORIZON JOIN energy_quotes q ON (t.symbol=q.symbol AND t.venue=q.source) LIST (-30s,0,1s,30s,5m,30m) AS h WHERE t.ts IN '2026-11-11'), perfill AS (SELECT trade_id,ts,book,trader,symbol,curve,venue,passive,qty,px,max(CASE WHEN horizon_s=0 THEN bps ELSE null END) b0,max(CASE WHEN horizon_s=30 THEN bps ELSE null END) b30,max(CASE WHEN horizon_s=300 THEN bps ELSE null END) b5,max(CASE WHEN horizon_s=1800 THEN bps ELSE null END) b1800,max(CASE WHEN horizon_s=0 THEN halfspread ELSE null END) halfspread,max(CASE WHEN horizon_s=0 THEN age_s ELSE null END) age0,max(CASE WHEN horizon_s=300 THEN age_s ELSE null END) age5 FROM obs GROUP BY trade_id,ts,book,trader,symbol,curve,venue,passive,qty,px) SELECT f.*,b5*px*abs(qty)*u.factor/10000 usd5 FROM perfill f JOIN energy_usd_factor_asof u ON (symbol) ORDER BY usd5 LIMIT 30

## Method and limits
Positive markout = sign(qty) * (future mid - fill). Bps use fill price. USD uses physical quantity, instrument px_factor and fixed Wednesday-close FX: EURUSD 1.10761, GBPUSD 1.32753. NBP is quoted in pence/therm and requires a 0.01 factor. Physical quantities are not aggregated across unlike products.

Exchange markouts preserve nanosecond timestamps and match the same venue's latest quote at or before each horizon. Broker/OTC use latest available cross-source quotes by symbol and latest trade versions booked by 12 Nov 09:20:15 UTC; cancellations are excluded. They are indicative benchmarks, with no size/depth adjustment. Mean bps are trade-weighted; the exchange scorecard also includes notional-weighted bps. Horizons cover -30s, 0, 1s, 30s, 5m and 30m. Quote ages are visible in the fill audit.

Counterparty residuals compare incremental 5m moves with at least 3 other trades in the same curve, UTC hour and side, excluding that counterparty. Exact tenor, size and order intent remain uncontrolled. Reported t-statistics are descriptive, with no adjustment for correlated trades or multiple testing.

Risk is separately reconstructed from opening snapshots, late prior-day trades and corrected Wednesday trade events. Book-time Brent control uses booked_ts and amendment/cancellation quantity deltas; no Brent book transfers occur in the supplied history. Economic risk restates prior-day late trades into the opening balance. Historical limit versions are unavailable.

Winter/summer labels mean delivery starts Nov-Feb / Mar-Oct. Data spans 10 Nov through 12 Nov about 09:20, with day-ahead delivery prices further ahead. Full available history was used for source/rollup/reference/IV checks; performance targets Wednesday, with Tuesday controls. Raw-to-minute OHLC reconciliation is sampled at 08:40-08:55; downstream rollup reconciliations cover all stored rows.

No fees/rebates, arrival-price parent orders, order/cancel logs, exchange opponent identities, historical master revisions, model-to-order links or option trade/Greek data are available. A full two-day raw-model ASOF scan timed out; independent raw-quote confirmation uses noon observations on both days, while the supplied graded view provides all-day model diagnostics.

Use the tab menu to export this notebook if you need a portable copy.

## Complete object-by-object coverage

| Object | Type | Checks and outcome |
|---|---|---|
| energy_book_asof | view | Pinned Wednesday close; 2,757 exchange, 141 broker and 75 OTC active trades. Compared with restated counts. |
| energy_book_restated | view | Deduplicated trade versions and cancellations; 149 broker and 101 OTC trades after late arrivals. |
| energy_curve_marks | table | Source/version review, manual versus corrected prices, and duration-weighted strip checks. Thirty TTF Q1 marks overstated by EUR 2.50/MWh. |
| energy_curve_marks_1h | materialized view | Recomputed all 14,094 hourly last prices from raw marks; zero difference. Bar timestamps denote interval starts. |
| energy_curve_marks_latest | view | Compared all 243 session-end marks with energy_marks_asof; zero difference. Checked manual-mark revision selection. |
| energy_da_prices | table | Inspected all 72 hourly prices, volumes and publication times. Highest GBP 257.22/MWh is 12 Nov delivery, published 11 Nov; not a matching forward fill benchmark. |
| energy_fills | table | Multi-horizon signed markouts, venue/passivity/side/season controls, quote ages and lot/tick checks. Gasoil signal confirmed; original exchange fills retained. |
| energy_fx_asof | view | Pinned historical FX; verified EURUSD 1.10761 and GBPUSD 1.32753 and zero missing required FX conversions. |
| energy_instrument_master | view | Checked per-curve row counts, distinct symbols and lot/tick sizes. Its 352 listing rows cover 243 instruments; joining on symbol alone can multiply fills. |
| energy_instruments | table | 243 unique symbols; delivery ranges, currency and conversion-factor validity, season labels and fill mappings checked. |
| energy_iv_marks | table | Inspected all history, five delta buckets per corrected surface, positive IV/tau and total-variance shape. Four TTF Mar ATM version-1 marks revised up 0.08; corrected surface removes four inversions. |
| energy_ledger | view | Verified composition: 172 opening rows and 2,757 fill rows on Wednesday. Broker/OTC events are omitted; not the complete position ledger. |
| energy_limits | table | Applied all 12 supplied book/curve limits to reconstructed native-unit positions. Brent exceeds supplied 2m-barrel limit; historical limit versions unavailable. |
| energy_lineage | view | Checked dependency statuses: 26 regular-view edges valid, 5 materialized-view edges valid, 2 live views active. |
| energy_listings | table | 243 symbols, exactly one primary each, liquidity shares sum to 1, positive lot/tick sizes. All 5,887 fills map by symbol and venue, with zero off-lot/off-tick fills. |
| energy_marks_asof | view | Pinned historical cutoffs, checked latest revision selection and alias reconciliation. Correctly selects TTF Q1 version 2. |
| energy_marks_live | view | Checked quote preference and fallback age. At session end: 186 quote-backed, 51 interpolated and 6 market-mark fallbacks; quote ages up to 289s. |
| energy_mid_1m_day | view | Compared all 236,791 Wednesday rows with energy_quotes_1m; zero close/tick differences. |
| energy_model_graded_day | view | Graded both models by curve and delivery season with historical day/asof. Champion winter monthly bias persists; benchmark uses previous-minute closes. |
| energy_model_prices | table | Compared both model versions, all input timestamps (0.5s age), seasonal errors and independent raw-quote noon controls on 10 and 11 Nov. |
| energy_position_snapshots | table | Checked unique book/symbol/venue keys and prior-settlement marks. All 351 later opening marks match. Wednesday-to-Thursday positions reconcile exactly across 107 keys after 32 late Tuesday trades are included. |
| energy_positions_live | live view | Compared all 2,757 Wednesday rows against fresh daily cumulative fill quantities; zero difference. It excludes opening inventory and non-exchange trades. |
| energy_positions_live_by_venue | live view | Compared all 2,757 Wednesday venue-level cumulative fill positions; zero difference. Same inventory/OTC scope limitation. |
| energy_positions_running_day | view | Pinned @day and reconciled cumulative position with fills/live output on all 2,757 rows; zero difference. Daily trading flow, not complete inventory. |
| energy_quotes | table | Checked all 78,797,579 quotes for crossed/nonpositive prices and negative sizes: zero invalid. Assessed gaps, sources, freshness and raw markouts; recorded EEX gap 08:45-08:48 UTC. |
| energy_quotes_10s | materialized view | Total ticks reconcile with 70,368,494 eligible raw quotes; minute closes/bid/ask reconcile across 548,253 rows. Definition excludes EEX. |
| energy_quotes_1d | materialized view | All 738 daily OHLC bars reconcile to 5m bars; eligible tick totals match. Partial last day distinguished from full sessions. |
| energy_quotes_1m | materialized view | Eligible tick totals match; 3,203 bars independently reconstructed from raw quotes at 08:40-08:55 on Wednesday have zero OHLC/tick differences. |
| energy_quotes_5m | materialized view | All 148,463 OHLC bars reconcile to 1m bars; eligible tick totals match. |
| energy_settlements | table | All 486 settlement prices match contemporaneous curve marks. Checked opening snapshot marks against prior settlements; first-day prior settlements are unavailable. |
| energy_strip_gaps_day | view | Ran duration-weighted strip/month consistency on both full days. Manual TTF Q1 gap about 2.50; other gaps below 0.01 native price units. No executable arbitrage claim. |
| energy_tenors | view | Compared alias with historical energy_tenors_asof: 243 unique instruments, same earliest expiry. |
| energy_tenors_asof | view | Pinned historical cutoff; inspected expiry and per-curve/granularity ranks and counts. Current-date defaults can change historical membership. |
| energy_trade_events | table | Checked NEW/amended/cancelled versions, actual trade versus booking times, counterparties, and late prior-day/current-session arrivals; used explicit audit cutoff. |
| energy_trade_events_latest | view | Compared with restated book at historical asof; same 2,757/149/101 channel counts and cancellation scope. |
| energy_usd_factor_asof | view | Verified factor per curve and required FX coverage. NBP factor is 0.0132753 USD per quoted pence, avoiding a 100-fold unit error. |
